😗 Went to the doctor to get some medicine because I was really sick. At the counter, they asked me what my symptoms were. “I said I had a headache, fever, sore throat, runny nose, and a nosebleed. It wasn’t as bad as a nosebleed, but it was definitely there.” The person at the counter said, “Okay.” Then they went into the examination room. The doctor said, “My throat isn’t red, my nose isn’t runny, and I don’t have a fever.” Okay, there might not be a fever because I took the medicine this morning because I had a headache and a high fever. As for the runny nose, I told them I had just blown my nose before coming. I was confused, “What’s with this thick feeling in my throat?” The doctor said, “It might be phlegm.” Oh, then you just said there wasn’t anything. The doctor asked if I wanted any more medicine and what medicines I had at home. So I asked for “throat medicine.” Because the doctor didn’t even check if there was blood in my nose. So I didn’t want anything and just asked to go home because I was already dizzy. If you don’t want to give me medicine, it’s okay. I didn’t ask for it for free. I paid for it. The doctor said, “Can I drink warm water instead?” I was confused, so I didn’t ask for any medicine. The doctor just gave me a throat spray. We came because we trusted him, because my father had recommended him. We came because we really came for a checkup, because we were really sick, not to buy a medical certificate. When we got home, there was still blood in our nose. We really wanted to go to the hospital, but we didn't have time, so we came to a nearby clinic instead.
